undead.label: A healthy bat and a nearly-dead one
undead.explanation: A level-14 Necromancer with both books faces a healthy vampire bat five grids away and a vampire bat hurt to a fifth of its hp three grids away; a wall sits just beyond each. The original rates the tap at each target's full hp, so it taps toward the healthy bat; the correction rates both taps at real damage, where the nearly-dead bat rates higher, and taps toward it.
